name: flowchart
description: Steps and decisions into a laid-out flowchart with SVG, PDF and Mermaid exports.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a list of steps and decisions into a clean flowchart you can download. Zovo Flowchart takes plain arrows such as "Start -> Check stock" or Mermaid flowchart text, lays the chart out in layers from top to bottom or left to right, and returns it as an SVG, a PDF and Mermaid text.

The layout keeps boxes apart, wraps long text inside each box, reorders each layer to reduce edge crossings, and routes arrows with right angles or straight lines. Edge labels such as yes and no sit in open space next to their arrow. Loops that go back up the chart are drawn dashed along the side, so the main flow stays readable.

It also checks the process. It refuses edges to node ids that do not exist and names the edge or line. It warns about decisions with fewer than two branches, steps that are not reachable from the start, and dead ends. Each result reports its own layout checks: overlapping boxes, labels that touch boxes, and the number of edge crossings.

Shapes: start and end, process, decision, input or output, and document.

In the chart you can pan, zoom, switch between top-down and left-right, and click a step to highlight the paths through it. Download an SVG for slides and docs, a vector PDF (sized to the chart, Letter or A4), or Mermaid text for wikis and code repositories.

Good for onboarding guides, support scripts, approval processes, sales and refund workflows, and teaching algorithms.

Limitations: up to 150 steps and 300 arrows, 120 characters per box and 40 per label. No swimlanes, subgraphs, custom colours or manual positions. The PDF uses standard fonts with Western European letters; other characters are simplified or shown as ? in the PDF only, with a note. Charts are not saved.
defaultPrompt: Flowchart: Start -> Receive order -> In stock?; In stock? -> Ship: yes; In stock? -> Reorder: no; Reorder -> Ship; Ship -> End
Left-right flowchart of a refund: request, receipt attached?, yes approve and pay out, no reject, then done
Draw this Mermaid as a PDF: flowchart TD; A([Login]) --> B{Valid?}; B -->|yes| C[Home]; B -->|no| A

positive.description: Order process with a yes and no branch
positive.prompt: Make a flowchart titled Order handling: Start -> Receive order -> In stock?; In stock? -> Ship order: yes; In stock? -> Reorder: no; Reorder -> Ship order; Ship order -> End
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flowchart with the steps as text. The chart shows 6 nodes and 6 edges in 6 layers: Start and End as rounded terminals, In stock? as a decision diamond with yes and no labels. The checks report 0 overlapping boxes and 0 edge crossings. The reply gives SVG, PDF and Mermaid download links; the PDF opens as one page.

positive.description: Mermaid text to a one-page PDF
positive.prompt: Turn this Mermaid into a Letter PDF flowchart: flowchart TD; A([Login]) --> B{Valid?}; B -->|yes| C[Home]; B -->|no| A
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flowchart with the Mermaid text and page_size letter. The chart has 3 nodes (Login as start, Valid? as decision, Home) and 3 edges. The no branch back to Login is a loop edge, drawn dashed along the side, and the reply notes 1 loop edge. The PDF download is one Letter page at 100% scale.

positive.description: Left-right refund workflow from structured steps
positive.prompt: Left-right flowchart titled Refunds: Refund request (start) -> Receipt attached?; yes -> Approve refund -> Pay out -> Done; no -> Reject and email customer -> Done
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flowchart with direction left-right. The chart has 6 nodes and 6 edges in 5 layers, Receipt attached? as a decision with yes and no branches, Done as the end. Checks report 0 overlapping boxes and 0 edge crossings. SVG, PDF and Mermaid downloads are offered.

positive.prompt: Check this process as a flowchart: Start -> Check ID -> Valid?; Valid? -> Enter: yes; Archive -> End
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flowchart. The chart draws 6 nodes and 4 edges. The reply warns that the decision Valid? has fewer than 2 outgoing edges and that 2 steps (Archive and End) are not reachable from the start, and suggests adding the missing no branch and connection.

positive.prompt: Flowchart with a retry loop: Start -> Call API -> OK?; OK? -> Save: yes; OK? -> Wait: no; Wait -> Call API; Save -> End
positive.expected_behavior: Calls generate_flowchart. The chart has 6 nodes and 6 edges in 5 layers; the edge from Wait back to Call API is 1 loop edge drawn dashed along the side. Checks report 0 overlapping boxes and 0 edge crossings, with SVG, PDF and Mermaid downloads.

negative.description: Charts of numbers are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant answers without a flowchart.
negative.prompt: Draw a bar chart of our monthly sales: Jan 120, Feb 135, Mar 98

negative.description: Sequence diagrams are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains it draws flowcharts only.
negative.prompt: Make a UML sequence diagram of the login messages between browser, API and database

negative.description: Editing a diagram in another app is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; the assistant explains it does not connect to other diagram apps.
negative.prompt: Open my Lucidchart document and move the Approve box to the left

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: flowcharts from arrows or Mermaid text, six shapes, layered layout with crossing reduction and no overlapping boxes, process checks, interactive chart, SVG, PDF and Mermaid downloads.

pl-PL.subtitle: Schematy blokowe z eksportem
pl-PL.description: Zamień listę kroków i decyzji w czytelny schemat blokowy. Zovo Flowchart przyjmuje strzałki takie jak "Start -> Sprawdź stan" albo tekst Mermaid, układa schemat warstwami z góry na dół lub od lewej do prawej i zwraca pliki SVG, PDF oraz tekst Mermaid. Układ rozsuwa pola, zawija długi tekst, zmniejsza liczbę przecięć i umieszcza etykiety tak i nie obok strzałek. Narzędzie sprawdza też proces: nieznane identyfikatory, decyzje z jedną gałęzią i kroki nieosiągalne od startu. Do 150 kroków i 300 strzałek.

de-DE.subtitle: Flussdiagramme mit Export
de-DE.description: Machen Sie aus Schritten und Entscheidungen ein sauberes Flussdiagramm. Zovo Flowchart nimmt Pfeile wie "Start -> Lager prüfen" oder Mermaid-Text, ordnet das Diagramm in Ebenen von oben nach unten oder von links nach rechts an und liefert SVG, PDF und Mermaid-Text. Kästen überlappen sich nicht, langer Text wird umbrochen, Kreuzungen werden reduziert und Beschriftungen wie ja und nein stehen neben ihrem Pfeil. Dazu prüft es den Ablauf: unbekannte IDs, Entscheidungen mit nur einem Zweig und unerreichbare Schritte. Bis zu 150 Schritte und 300 Pfeile.

es-ES.subtitle: Diagramas de flujo exportables
es-ES.description: Convierte una lista de pasos y decisiones en un diagrama de flujo claro. Zovo Flowchart acepta flechas como "Inicio -> Revisar stock" o texto Mermaid, organiza el diagrama por capas de arriba abajo o de izquierda a derecha y devuelve SVG, PDF y texto Mermaid. Las cajas no se solapan, el texto largo se ajusta, se reducen los cruces y las etiquetas sí y no quedan junto a su flecha. También revisa el proceso: identificadores desconocidos, decisiones con una sola rama y pasos inalcanzables. Hasta 150 pasos y 300 flechas.

fr-FR.subtitle: Logigrammes prêts à exporter
fr-FR.description: Transformez une liste d'étapes et de décisions en logigramme lisible. Zovo Flowchart accepte des flèches comme "Début -> Vérifier le stock" ou du texte Mermaid, dispose le schéma par niveaux de haut en bas ou de gauche à droite et fournit un SVG, un PDF et le texte Mermaid. Les boîtes ne se chevauchent pas, le texte long est renvoyé à la ligne, les croisements sont réduits et les étiquettes oui et non restent près de leur flèche. Il vérifie aussi le processus : identifiants inconnus, décisions à une seule branche et étapes inaccessibles. Jusqu'à 150 étapes et 300 flèches.

ja-JP.subtitle: フローチャート作成と書き出し
ja-JP.description: 手順と分岐のリストを見やすいフローチャートにします。Zovo Flowchart は「開始 -> 在庫確認」のような矢印や Mermaid のテキストを受け取り、上から下または左から右に階層で配置して、SVG、PDF、Mermaid テキストを返します。ボックスは重ならず、長い文は折り返され、交差を減らし、はい・いいえのラベルは矢印の横に置かれます。未定義の ID、分岐が一つしかない判断、開始から到達できない手順も確認します。最大 150 ステップ、300 本の矢印まで。

pt-BR.subtitle: Fluxogramas para exportar
pt-BR.description: Transforme uma lista de etapas e decisões em um fluxograma claro. O Zovo Flowchart aceita setas como "Início -> Verificar estoque" ou texto Mermaid, organiza o diagrama em camadas de cima para baixo ou da esquerda para a direita e devolve SVG, PDF e texto Mermaid. As caixas não se sobrepõem, o texto longo quebra a linha, os cruzamentos diminuem e os rótulos sim e não ficam ao lado da seta. Também verifica o processo: IDs desconhecidos, decisões com um só ramo e etapas inalcançáveis. Até 150 etapas e 300 setas.
